title: Gucci perfume: Bloom, Flora Gorgeous, Guilty and Intense Oud compared
body:
Gucci's fragrances fall into a few clear lines: Bloom, a family of white florals; Flora Gorgeous, three sweeter, brighter florals; Guilty, with a version for her and one for him; and Intense Oud, a darker unisex scent. Here is every Gucci perfume we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

Gucci Bloom: a family of white florals

Every Bloom fragrance is built around jasmine, tuberose and Rangoon creeper, a climbing flower with a soft, almondy scent. The versions differ in what surrounds those flowers:

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum is the full, creamy original, here in a gift set (£84.99) with a 100ml bottle, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml body lotion for layering.
  • Bloom Eau de Toilette (£18.95, 10ml) is the lightest: neroli, bergamot and mandarin brighten the flowers, over musk and sandalwood. An easy daytime floral.
  • Bloom Profumo di Fiori (£16.95, 10ml pen spray) adds ylang-ylang to the bouquet, over sandalwood, benzoin, orris and musk: lusher and more golden.
  • Bloom Parfum (10ml, currently out of stock) is the richest, with apricot and cardamom at the top and vanilla, a sweet moss accord and Peru balsam underneath.

Want two Bloom minis plus two of Flora Gorgeous Gardenia? The Gucci women's miniature set (£39.99) holds four 5ml bottles.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous: sweeter, brighter florals

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum (£59.99, 50ml) centres on white gardenia and jasmine grandiflorum, with pear blossom for a light fruity touch and a brown sugar accord for softness. Bright rather than heavy, it suits sunny days, brunch and the office.

Flora Gorgeous Orchid (£17.99, 10ml) is the creamy one: a vanilla duo and vanilla orchid, lifted by an airy ozonic accord. A cosy choice for winter evenings.

Can't decide? The Flora Gorgeous Miniature Set (£44.99) has 5ml each of Gardenia, Orchid and Magnolia. Magnolia, only in the set, is the fruitiest: dewberries and coconut with magnolia and jasmine sambac, over patchouli and blond woods.

Gucci Guilty: for her and for him

The Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£47.99) pairs a 50ml bottle with a 50ml body lotion. It opens with mandora, bergamot and pink pepper, has a powdery heart of lilac, rose, violet and geranium, and settles on patchouli and amber: a warm floral amber for evenings and cooler months. The 10ml Guilty Pour Femme mini is currently out of stock.

Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette (£59.99, 90ml) is fresh and aromatic: Italian lemon and pink pepper, then orange blossom, neroli and French lavender, over patchouli and cedarwood. Clean and easy to wear, it suits the office, weekends and warmer days.

Gucci Intense Oud

Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum (£73.99, 90ml) is the darkest Gucci we stock and is unisex: black pepper and olibanum (frankincense) open it, amber woods, sandalwood and cedarwood follow, and leather, patchouli, gurjun balsam and an oud accord make the base. Our oud perfume guide compares it with Tom Ford Oud Wood and other oud fragrances.

Which Gucci perfume should you choose?

  • You love classic white flowers: Bloom eau de parfum, or the Bloom eau de toilette for something lighter.
  • You want a bright, cheerful floral: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia.
  • You like vanilla and soft sweetness: Flora Gorgeous Orchid.
  • You prefer a warmer, powdery evening scent: Guilty Pour Femme.
  • Buying for him: Guilty Pour Homme for fresh and clean, Intense Oud for smoky and woody.
  • You want to try before you commit: one of the 10ml minis or a 5ml set.

Good to know

  • Eau de toilette, eau de parfum or parfum? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Layering: the Bloom and Guilty Pour Femme sets come with a matching body lotion; apply the lotion first and spray over it.
  • As a gift: see our perfume gift sets guide and mini perfume sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Shop every Gucci fragrance, or browse perfume for women, perfume for men and floral fragrances.
summary: Every Gucci fragrance we stock, side by side: the Bloom family, Flora Gorgeous Gardenia, Orchid and Magnolia, Guilty for her and for him, and Intense Oud.
